notes: Read SKILL.md and all seven references/*.md in full. A bootstrap skill that tells the agent to check for and invoke applicable skills before responding, and maps skill actions to the tools of several agent harnesses.

Risk raised to medium although the scanner rates it low: it is meant to load at the start of every conversation and uses emphatic language to override default behavior. It states that user instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, direct requests) take precedence and tells subagents to ignore it.

It refers to other superpowers skills (brainstorming, systematic-debugging) that are not part of this artifact; brainstorming is blocked in this catalog. Reference files suggest config.toml settings for the user to add; they do not edit files themselves.
